subject: info-trns
title: (R)INFO.TRNS.----- PHY.U.P.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 171 (SR(TRS)II-27). INFO-TRNS (information transference) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) is the partner. From the subject: TRS (transition), INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From TRS: ALT-F (alternative functionalism) and TH-CONT-DY (thrust continuance dynamics). From VT-DY: PR-TRS and WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle). From ALT-F: SOC-RT (social reality). From WO-EXP-PRI: ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics).
